subject: Quality checks before furniture leaves the workshop
hook: Before any panel leaves our Hanley workshop, it gets checked six ways.
ig:
Before any panel leaves our Hanley workshop, it gets checked six ways.

If you're a fitter, joiner or kitchen installer buying in cut and edged parts, this is what we check before your order goes out:

1. Size against your cutting list, part by part.
2. Square, by measuring both diagonals.
3. Edging: bonded, trimmed flush, corners clean, no glue line.
4. Drilling: hinge cups, shelf-pin rows and dowels against the drawing, on the right face.
5. Faces: no chips, scuffs or marks from handling.
6. Labels and wrapping: every part named to your list so assembly on site is quick.

The aim is simple: what turns up on your job is what you ordered, ready to build.

We cut on a sliding table panel saw, edge with ABS edging in 0.4, 1 and 2 mm, and drill on a multi-spindle boring machine.

Got a job coming up? Send your cutting list for a priced quote; details via link in bio.
fb:
For the trade: here's what happens to your order in our Hanley workshop before it's ready to collect.

Every part is measured against your cutting list, checked square by its diagonals, edging inspected for lift, overhang and glue lines, drilling checked against your drawing, faces inspected for chips, and everything labelled to your list and wrapped.

Panel cutting, ABS edge banding, drilling and cabinet assembly, trade and domestic orders welcome. Send us a cutting list for a priced quote.

on_asset:
S1: Six checks before a panel leaves / What trade customers should expect |
S2: Size against the cutting list — Each part is measured against your list, not against the part next to it, so one error can't copy itself down the stack. |
S3: Square, by the diagonals — Measuring corner to corner on both diagonals shows if a panel is out of square before it becomes a door that won't sit right. |
S4: Edging stuck, trimmed, clean — Run a hand along it: no lifting, no overhang, corners trimmed, no glue line showing on the face. |
S5: Holes where the drawing says — Hinge cups, shelf-pin rows and dowel holes checked against the drawing and the right face. |
S6: Faces, labels, wrapping — Faces inspected for chips and marks, each part labelled to your list, then wrapped for collection or delivery. |
S7: Checked before it's collected — Send us your cutting list for a priced quote. Link in bio.
